title: Exact proof layers are disjoint
statement: If m ̸= n, then LF (Γ, m) ∩ LF (Γ, n) = ∅.
proof: A formula has one well-defined minimum proof length. It cannot simultaneously have two distinct minima.
intended_use: Makes the breadth-first proof horizon into a genuine layer decomposition.

title: p-simulation chains compose polynomial overheads
statement: A finite chain of p-simulations is again a p-simulation; the certificate-size/time overhead is bounded by a polynomial obtained by composing the finitely many polynomial translators.
proof: Proposition 10.11 gives transitivity. A finite composition of polynomials is polynomial.
intended_use: Supports modular proof-system translations without leaving polynomial overhead.

title: Quantitative clock bounds compose
statement: Suppose G ⪯clk H has clock ρ1 (n) ≤ τ1 (n) and H ⪯clk K has clock ρ2 (n) ≤ τ2 (n), where the bounding functions are nondecreasing on positive integers. The composite witness has clock ρ2 (ρ1 (n)) ≤ τ2 (τ1 (n)).
proof: The source composition uses ρ2 ◦ ρ1. Bound its outer function by τ2, then use monotonicity of τ2 and the bound on ρ1.
intended_use: Permits chains of quantitative simulations while charging their accumulated distortion.

title: Finite compiled workloads can be accelerated without adding theorems
statement: For any finite family of already provable designated targets covered by Corollary 7.13, one may add conservative derived rules tailored to that workload while preserving the original consequence set.
proof: Corollary 7.13 supplies the finite-workload compilation, and Theorem 7.12 supplies conservativity.
intended_use: Provides a model of safe proof engineering for a frozen finite benchmark.

title: Two rule invariants can be conjoined
statement: If properties P and Q each hold on the hypotheses and are each preserved by every rule, then every consequence satisfies P ∧ Q.
proof: The conjunction holds initially. A rule whose conclusion preserves both P and Q preserves their conjunction. Apply rule induction once to P ∧ Q.
intended_use: Allows independent safety properties to be accumulated without increasing theorem fan-in.

title: Clocked simulations compose with composed clocks
statement: If (f, ρ) simulates M in N and (g, σ) simulates N in P, then (g ◦ f, σ ◦ ρ) simulates M in P.
proof: This is exactly the composition construction of Proposition 3.19; injectivity and the state/halting identities compose, and the composite clock remains admissible.
intended_use: Provides the basic arithmetic for multi-stage scheduler embeddings.

title: A complex target-search ATP may still have level zero
statement: The corrected algebraic target-search machine G can satisfy the source complexity criterion while remaining at formal self- awareness level 0.
proof: Corrected Proposition 18.17 establishes the target-search/proof-system properties; Proposition 18.18 records the complexity clause together with level zero.
intended_use: Demonstrates that proof-search sophistication and formal self-reflection are distinct axes.

title: Reachability and forced distance can have arbitrarily large gaps
statement: For every L ≥ 1 there is a finite strategic graph with dist(s, W) = 1 and Hforce (s, W) = L.
proof: For L = 1, use a single edge to a target. For L ≥ 2, make s environment-owned with two choices: an edge directly to a target, and an edge starting a deterministic route whose total length from s to a target is L. Every play settles; the environment chooses the longer route in the worst case.
intended_use: Shows that the numerical gap is not bounded merely by the existence of a one-step successful route.

title: The specified transfinite calculus realizes every level up to its stated bound
statement: For every ordinal δ ≤ κ covered by the theorem, there exists a tagged ATP Mδ with the corresponding transfinite reflection behavior stated in Theorem 21.15.
proof: The theorem provides the witnesses directly, conditional on the specified transfinite calculus and limit clauses.
intended_use: Shows how the finite hierarchy can be extended only after the missing limit-stage structure is explicitly supplied.

title: Exact proof budgets are exact reachability budgets
statement: For n ≥ 0, T has a proof using at most n primitive inference applications from B0 exactly when the lifted target region is reachable in at most n transitions.
proof: Lift a proof line by line, or read the inference labels on a path. The correspondence preserves the number of primitive inference applications.
intended_use: Allows a target-specific mining request to specify an auditable inference budget.

title: Effective non-simulation follows from ordinary non-simulation
statement: If M ̸⪯ N, then no effective clocked simulation M ⪯eff N exists.
proof: Proposition 3.26 states that effective clocked simulation implies ordinary clocked simulation. Contraposition gives the claim.
intended_use: Lets unrestricted obstructions be reused in the effective setting.

title: Causal depth gives a sharper target-specific rank bound
statement: Every deposited formula satisfies r(λ) ≤ r0 + dδ(λ), hence δ(λ) ≥ ⌈max{0, r(λ) − r0 }/d⌉.
proof: Theorem 8.3 follows only the actual recursively expanded dependency ancestry of λ rather than charging every earlier deposit.
intended_use: Provides a schedule-insensitive lower bound focused on the target’s causal certificate structure.

title: Affine distortion remains affine under composition
statement: If τ1 (n) = an + b and τ2 (n) = cn + d, with nonnegative coefficients and valid nondecreasing integer-valued bounds, the final hitting stage is at most ca n + cb + d.
proof: Substitute the affine expressions into τ2 (τ1 (n)).
intended_use: Exposes the constants that a qualitative degree comparison leaves unspecified.

title: Bounded-latency scheduling gives a quantitative emulation bound
statement: Suppose a baseline-preserving prover needs m ≥ 1 local transitions. Assume that, unless settlement has occurred, each consecutive block of b ≥ 1 global rounds grants at least one baseline local opportunity, starting with rounds 1,..., b. Foreign deposits can be ignored. Then every admissible play settles by round bm.
hypotheses: the modified service condition stated here
proof: If the play is still unsettled, after j complete blocks the prover has received at least j opportunities. Baseline preservation reproduces the first j baseline transitions. At the end of block m its baseline certificate has been obtained, unless a different settlement occurred earlier.
intended_use: Generalizes the source unit-rate guarantee to a practical service-latency contract.

title: Eventual service gives eventual settlement without a uniform round bound
statement: If an unsettled play grants infinitely many baseline opportunities to a prover whose baseline proof takes finitely many local steps, that play eventually settles. Mere eventual-service fairness does not provide one uniform finite global-round bound across all fair plays.
proof: The required mth opportunity occurs at some finite round on each such play, yielding the baseline proof. For lack of a uniform bound, use a one-step baseline prover and let the scheduler delay its first service for any chosen finite number L of rounds, then service it. Every such schedule is fair, but settlement times are unbounded as L varies.
intended_use: Separates per-play termination from a shared worst-case scheduling guarantee.

title: Certificate-preserved formula properties survive cooperative BANK birth
statement: Every object-level formula deposited at finite BANK birth time has any property P that holds on B0 and is preserved by all primitive rules inside accepted expanded deposit certificates.
proof: Theorem 3.2 uses strong induction on BANK birth time plus finite induction through each certificate DAG.
intended_use: Moves invariant reasoning across channels while keeping proof obligations local.

title: Fixed-degree Polynomial Calculus search is an algorithmic rather than merely existential state-
statement: For each fixed degree bound d, the source theorem supplies a procedure that finds bounded-degree refutations when they exist; existence inside that fixed degree class is therefore accompanied by effective search.
proof: Theorem 10.47 is explicitly a findability theorem at fixed degree. No claim is made when the required degree grows outside its hypotheses.
intended_use: Separates bounded structural complexity from unrestricted proof search.

title: Level descends to the admissible quotient
statement: Mutually admissibly equivalent ATPs have equal level, so [M ] 7→ lev(M) is well defined on quotient classes and order preserving.
proof: Corollary 16.19 states both well-definedness and monotonicity on classes.
intended_use: Supports degree-level cataloguing of formal self-awareness.

title: Complete control equates intrinsic and forced horizons
statement: In a graph whose every nonterminal choice is controller-owned, Hforce (s, W) = dist(s, W).
proof: A finite shortest path can be followed by the controller, providing a forcing strategy of that length. The source inequality provides the reverse bound. If the target is unreachable, neither a path nor a forcing strategy exists.
intended_use: Identifies a precise case in which two levels of the hierarchy coincide.

title: A one-step Bellman equation for proof distance
statement: Let h(S) = dist(S, WT) in the unit-cost logical derivation graph. If S ∈ WT, then h(S) = 0. Otherwise h(S) = 1 + min U ∈Succ(S) h(U), where min ∅ = ∞ and 1 + ∞ = ∞.
proof: Every nonzero-length target path has a first successor and a suffix. Conversely a target path from a successor can be prefixed by its incoming edge. Taking minimum lengths in these two directions proves equality.
intended_use: Describes what a perfect one-step hint would have to optimize; it does not provide an efficient algorithm for evaluating h.

title: Conservative BANK growth leaves consequence closure unchanged
statement: If every accepted object deposit is derivable from the immediately preceding object BANK, then ConF (Bkobj) = ConF (B0) for every stage k.
proof: Theorem 2.2 proves both inclusion of every deposited formula in the original closure and equality of closures by monotonicity and idempotence.
intended_use: Formalizes BANK as road-building rather than new axiomatization.

title: Finite forced horizon provides a decreasing rank
statement: If s ∈ / W has finite forced horizon r, a controller-owned s has a successor of horizon at most r − 1, while every successor of an environment-owned s has horizon at most r − 1.
proof: A nonterminal state first enters Ar through the existential predecessor clause for controller states or the universal nonempty- successor clause for environment states. Those clauses refer to Ar−1.
intended_use: Turns the backward construction into a finite progress certificate for a forcing strategy.

title: Changing the tag spelling does not change the represented machine
statement: If two distinguished tags name the same ATP, uniform renaming between them preserves the underlying tagged-object relation.
proof: This is the renaming invariance of Proposition 13.4.
intended_use: Prevents notation from being mistaken for a substantive change in self-reference.

title: Structural induction reduces a global WFF property to grammar clauses
statement: Under the least-generated grammar hypotheses of Supplement Theorem 2, a property holding on every base formation and preserved by every formation constructor holds for every WFF.
proof: This is the structural induction theorem applied to the grammar’s generation tree.
intended_use: Makes explicit when induction on syntax is justified and when a bare arbitrary WFF set is insufficient.

title: Observation spectra descend to degrees
statement: If M ∼clk N, then Obs(M) = Obs(N). Hence [M ] 7→ Obs(M) is a well-defined monotone function on clocked degrees.
proof: The simulations in the two directions give both inclusions by the source theorem. Monotonicity on representatives then descends using equality on equivalence classes.
intended_use: Makes observation spectra usable as degree-level database keys, although equality of spectra is not claimed to classify all dynamic degrees.

title: No finite chain cover
statement: The clocked-degree poset, even restricted to the finitely describable machines appearing in the source antichain, cannot be covered by finitely many chains.
proof: Let A be the countably infinite antichain. Each chain meets A in at most one element. A union of m chains therefore covers at most m elements of A, and cannot cover A.
intended_use: Rules out organizing all such machines into finitely many linear ladders of simulation strength.

title: Effective degrees have no finite chain cover
statement: The effective degree poset is not a well-quasi-order and cannot be covered by finitely many chains.
proof: The source theorem supplies a countably infinite effective antichain. Its enumeration violates well-quasi-ordering, and each chain covers at most one of its elements.
intended_use: Shows that restricting to executable witnesses does not restore a finite linear classification.

title: A proved self-description creates a nonempty self-model
statement: If the machine proves the designated ATP statement about its own tag, its self-model is nonempty.
proof: The proved self-descriptive formula is itself an element witnessing nonemptiness, as recorded in Proposition 13.8.
intended_use: Gives the minimal bridge from proof to formal self-model content.

title: A nonincreasing rank is an absolute reachability obstruction above the initial maximum
statement: If every inference satisfies r(β) ≤ maxi r(αi), then no derived formula can have rank greater than the maximum rank already present in the input.
proof: Proposition 17 says the rank maximum is preserved as an invariant; hence values above it are unreachable.
intended_use: Turns a potential function into a simple impossibility certificate.

title: Rule-driven ATP soundness is a special case of formula-invariant induction
statement: For a rule-driven ATP beginning from Γ, every formula produced is provable from Γ.
proof: Take P (ψ) to mean Γ ⊢F ψ in the invariant method. Premises satisfy it and each legal inference preserves it; Corollary 8 records the resulting soundness claim.
intended_use: Shows that proof-search soundness can be packaged as an invariant rather than reproved per stage.

title: Rule-driven states contain no unproved formulas
statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition 2.15, if φ ∈ / ConF (Γ) then φ ∈ / C(Γ, m) for every stage m.
proof: Proposition 2.15 gives C(Γ, m) ⊆ ConF (Γ) ∩ Y. Take the contrapositive of membership.
intended_use: Separates sound search failure from the stronger claim of unprovability.

title: Mechanism properties and self-theory properties can come apart
statement: Within the corrected scope, there is a property of the full presented mechanism that is not determined solely by the self-theory.
proof: Corrected Proposition 22.4 supplies the separation example at the appropriate presentation level.
intended_use: Prevents a theorem set from being treated as a complete description of mechanism structure.

title: A strict level inequality is a non-simulation certificate
statement: If lev(M) > lev(N), then M ̸⪯adm SA N.
proof: Otherwise LF-SA16.5 would imply lev(M) ≤ lev(N), a contradiction.
intended_use: Provides an inexpensive obstruction to one direction of the self-awareness preorder.

title: Reachable endpoints cannot outnumber histories
statement: If Mn (S0) is finite, the number of distinct endpoints of length-n histories is at most Mn (S0). Equality holds exactly when no two such histories have the same endpoint.
proof: The endpoint map is a surjection from the finite set of histories onto its image. Equal cardinalities occur exactly when that map is injective.
intended_use: Quantifies the distinction between proof histories and states without assuming that their counts coincide.

title: Provability of a reflection formula places it in the self-theory
statement: If M ⊢ θk, then θk ∈ Self(M).
proof: Corollary 15.13 records this because each θk is self-descriptive and proved by M.
intended_use: Connects reflection achievement to the machine’s designated self-descriptive theorem set.

title: Finite levels are cumulative under provability soundness
statement: Under the theorem’s soundness hypotheses, Level n implies every lower positive finite level.
proof: Theorem 15.22 proves cumulativity by unpacking the reflection sequence and the relevant soundness condition.
intended_use: Makes the finite hierarchy nested once its necessary hypothesis is stated.

title: Level is monotone under admissible comparison
statement: If M ⪯adm SA N, then lev(M) ≤ lev(N).
proof: This is Theorem 16.18, based on preservation of reflection formulas under the admissible translation.
intended_use: Turns the level function into an order invariant rather than a presentation artifact.

title: Later refinement cannot move first settlement later
statement: If first settlement occurs at stage h, later accepted settlement records may enlarge Σk but the stored first-settlement time remains h.
proof: Proposition 4.2 uses the absorbing first-time field and append-only settlement set.
intended_use: Allows dependence to be refined by a proof or refutation without rewriting history.

title: A proof arriving after dependence refines status without changing historical first settlement
statement: If D settles first at stage h and P later supplies a valid proof at stage k > h, then both records may be present at stage k while τAset = h.
proof: LF-A4.2 permits Σh ⊆ Σk while keeping the first-settlement time absorbing.
intended_use: Separates earliest certified information from later, more specific certified information.

title: A purely formal reflection-closure machine realizes level omega
statement: There exists a tagged ATP R in the source construction with level ω that derives the full finite reflection sequence.
proof: Theorem 21.1 supplies the machine and its properties.
intended_use: Gives a non-human formal witness for the top finite-reflection level.

title: The exhaustive configuration enumerator is sound and complete
statement: The SIC ET is rule-driven and deductively effective over the configuration formal system.
proof: This is Proposition B.8.
intended_use: Provides an explicit computational example of the general rule-enumeration architecture.

title: A nonstarved baseline-preserving prover cannot lose the stand-alone logical-round deadline
statement: If the stand-alone prover proves T in m local transitions, then under baseline preservation and unit-rate nonstarvation the AMLD either settles earlier through another role or reproduces the proof by global round m.
proof: Theorem 6.3 gives P at least m opportunities by round m and lets it ignore foreign deposits and mimic the stand-alone path.
intended_use: Provides a no-regret guarantee under a precisely stated logical-round resource convention.

title: Finite support of a derived theorem
statement: If B ⊢F T, then some finite B∗ ⊆ B satisfies B∗ ⊢F T.
proof: A finite proof has only finitely many premise occurrences. Collect those members of B used in the proof into B∗. The same proof is valid from B∗.
intended_use: Localizes an infinite premise pool to the finite support of an individual certificate.

title: Finite-pattern obstruction to simulation
statement: If a finite pattern lies in Obs(M)\Obs(N), then M ̸⪯clk N. If there is also a pattern in Obs(N)\Obs(M), the two machines are incomparable.
proof: A simulation would force the inclusion contradicted by the first pattern. Apply the same argument in reverse for incomparability.
intended_use: Gives a targeted theorem-search objective: look for a synchronized pattern realized on only one side.

title: Formula invariants persist at every stage of a rule-driven ATP
statement: Under the hypotheses of ATP formula-invariant induction, every formula appearing at any stage has the invariant property.
proof: The theorem inducts over stages: old formulas retain the property and newly admitted formulas inherit it from rule-preserving premises.
intended_use: Turns local rule checks into a run-wide search invariant.

title: Cumulative certificate depth upper-bounds attainable rank
statement: Under the theorem’s local rank-increment bound d, every formula in Bnobj has rank at most r0 + dQn.
proof: Theorem 8.1 accumulates at most dqi additional rank across each accepted certificate segment and sums those segment bounds.
intended_use: Converts a local inference constraint into a global cooperative growth bound.

title: A union of sound branches is sound
statement: If every branch state generated under the hypotheses of the branch-soundness theorem contains only consequences of Γ, then the union of all branch states also contains only consequences of Γ.
proof: Each element of the union lies in some branch state, which is sound by Theorem 5.6.
intended_use: Allows nondeterministic exploration to pool results without weakening correctness.

title: Internal necessitation propagates finite reflection one level at a time
statement: If a tagged machine proves the base reflection formula and has the source internal-necessitation property, then it proves every finite reflection iterate.
proof: Proposition 19 performs ordinary induction on the reflection index, using internal necessitation for the successor step.
intended_use: Separates finite reflection induction from any transfinite limit construction.

title: Infinite width does not exclude a greatest element
statement: There is a countable poset with a countably infinite antichain and a greatest element.
proof: Take distinct elements a0, a1,... and a new element ⊤. Declare ai ≤ ⊤ for all i, retain reflexivity, and introduce no comparisons between distinct ai. This is a poset with the stated properties.
intended_use: Blocks an invalid inference from the source antichain theorem.

title: Self-theory contains only the machine’s theorems
statement: For every tagged ATP M, Self(M) is a subset of the formulas provable by M.
proof: This is Proposition 13.10 by the definition of self-theory as the proved self-descriptive fragment.
intended_use: Places the self-theory firmly inside ordinary theoremhood.

title: Safe ranking can nevertheless miss a reachable target forever
statement: There is a sound legal-action policy with infinite hitting time for a reachable target.
proof: Let an operational state have a legal self-loop and a legal edge to an accepted target. The policy that always selects the self-loop uses only legal actions and never accepts a false theorem, but never visits the target.
intended_use: Shows why an independent fairness condition is needed when the aim is eventual discovery.

title: A consistent potential lower-bounds target distance
statement: Let ℓ: S → [0, ∞) satisfy ℓ(w) = 0 for w ∈ W and ℓ(s) ≤ 1 + ℓ(t) on every legal edge s → t. Then ℓ(s) ≤ dist(s, W).
proof: Along any length-n path to a target, repeated application of the edge inequality gives ℓ(s) ≤ n + ℓ(w) = n. Minimize over target paths. When none exists the claimed upper bound is infinite.
intended_use: Supplies one sufficient bridge for the source’s admissible-heuristic question.

title: A wall-clock win can coexist with greater total work
statement: Under replicated resources the AMLD may settle no later in wall-clock time than the stand-alone prover while still performing more aggregate work across its roles.
proof: Proposition 6.5 controls wall-clock time under replication. Proposition 7.1 explicitly allows excess work by losing roles. The two metrics therefore need not move together.
intended_use: Provides a concrete two-metric caution for evaluating cooperative ATPs.

title: First settlement is the minimum of the five role times
statement: In the extended natural numbers, τAset (T) = min{τAP, τAR, τAD, τAI, τAC }.
proof: Proposition 4.1 unfolds the definition of first acceptance among the five designated certificate classes.
intended_use: Gives an exact aggregation law for the multi-role architecture.

title: Finite-workload compilation does not imply an asymptotic speedup family
statement: A speedup obtained by compiling finitely many targets does not by itself prove an asymptotic proofcomplexity separation on an infinite target family.
proof: Corollary 7.14 states exactly this scope boundary: finite designated-target compilation is not an asymptotic theorem.
intended_use: Prevents a benchmark optimization from being promoted into a complexity-class claim.

title: Conservative cooperation cannot change provability status of T, T-minus, or contradiction
statement: Under conservative object-BANK growth, the truth values of Bk ⊢ T, Bk ⊢ T −, and Bk ⊢ ⊥ are independent of k.
proof: Corollary 2.3 follows because the consequence closure is constant.
intended_use: Separates improved access from changed logical status.

title: Sound internal necessitation creates a zero-or-omega dichotomy
statement: For a provability-sound ATP with internal necessitation, the level is either 0 or ω; no positive finite intermediate level occurs.
proof: This is Proposition 15.29: once Level 1 is present, internal necessitation drives all finite reflection; otherwise the level remains zero.
intended_use: Identifies a structural condition that collapses the finite middle of the hierarchy.

title: Object-BANK enlargement cannot increase P/R/C shortest explicitpremise horizons
statement: obj For J ∈ {P, R, C}, hJ (k + 1) ≤ hJ (k) whenever Bkobj ⊆ Bk+1.
proof: Every old proof remains a legal proof from the enlarged premise set, so the new minimum cannot be larger.
intended_use: Formalizes the narrow sense in which shared verified lemmas can only improve available proof routes.

title: Distance and realized hitting time distribute over finite target unions
statement: For W = i=1 Wi with r ≥ 1, Sr dist(s, W) = min dist(s, Wi), i Hπhit (W) = min Hπhit (Wi). i Both equalities allow infinite values.
proof: A path, or a time on a fixed trajectory, reaches the union exactly when it reaches at least one constituent region. Taking the earliest such length or time gives the minimum.
intended_use: Explains the first-settlement minimum while retaining the typing of the separate certificate regions.

title: The Tegmark condition occurs at every positive advertised level
statement: For every positive finite level and for ω in the source range, there is a tagged ATP satisfying the Tegmark condition at that level.
proof: Proposition 17.9 supplies the witnesses.
intended_use: Shows that the Tegmark condition does not force one unique reflection level.

title: Sharing repeated lemma uses avoids repeated expansion
statement: Suppose a lemma λ has a fixed acyclic certificate from B with q primitive inference nodes. Suppose a later certificate for T from B ∪ {λ} has r primitive inference nodes and any finite number of uses of λ. In a reusable certificate-DAG representation there is a certificate of T from B with at most q + r inference nodes.
proof: Insert the lemma’s DAG once before the later certificate and redirect every premise reference to λ to its conclusion node. Retain the later r nodes and all their dependencies. The resulting graph is acyclic because the lemma’s derivation depends only on B, and every redirected edge points from that earlier derivation into the later one.
intended_use: Quantifies proof sharing under a declared DAG cost model.

title: Forcing a settlement union can be easier than forcing any fixed role
statement: Always Hforce (s, i Wi) ≤ mini Hforce (s, Wi). Equality need not hold: the left side can be one while every term on the right is infinite. S
proof: Any strategy forcing one region forces the union. For strictness, let the environment choose in one step between two terminal states w1 and w2, and take Wi = {wi }. Every choice reaches the union in one step. For either fixed target Wi, the environment can choose the other terminal and avoid it forever.
intended_use: A strategic consequence specific to multi-channel settlement: robust first settlement need not identify in advance which role will settle.

title: Recoded SICs occupy the same synchronous and clocked degree
statement: For a SIC and its invertibly recoded copy, both synchronous and clocked mutual simulations hold.
proof: Theorem 4.12 supplies the two simulation directions using the recoding and its inverse.
intended_use: Separates representational identity from genuinely different operational power.

title: Polynomial Calculus inherits polynomial translations of resolution proofs
statement: Every resolution proof in the source setting has a Polynomial Calculus proof with polynomially related size.
proof: Theorem 10.43 states that Polynomial Calculus p-simulates resolution. Unpack the definition of p-simulation.
intended_use: Provides a one-way proof-translation guarantee while allowing the reverse direction to be harder.

title: Ordinary non-simulation survives effectiveness restrictions
statement: If M ̸⪯clk N for unrestricted clocked witnesses, there is no effective clocked simulation from M to N.
proof: An effective witness is also an unrestricted witness. Existence of the former would contradict absence of the latter.
intended_use: Transfers negative results without requiring a separate computability obstruction.

title: A bounded unsuccessful search trace does not certify unreachability
statement: For every n ≥ 0, there are two rooted transition systems with identical observed nonterminal prefixes through n steps, one with a target at step n + 1 and one with no reachable target.
proof: Use a deterministic chain s0 → · · · → sn with no target labels. In one extension add sn → w with w a target. In the other add an edge from sn to a new non-target state with a self-loop. The prefixes and observations through step n coincide, but their reachability answers differ.
intended_use: Shows the information missing from a timeout trace alone.

title: Level omega does not exhaust Picard’s self-theory
statement: Under the Picard idealization, the self-theory strictly extends the finite reflection tower rather than being equal to it.
proof: Corollary 20.17 states the strict extension.
intended_use: Shows that the level invariant records only one structured slice of self-descriptive theoremhood.

title: Pure invertible recoding cannot by itself create a transaction advantage
statement: Under the hypotheses of the no-free-recoding-speedup theorem, any claimed transaction reduction must use more than the invertible recoding alone.
proof: Theorem 4.34 excludes a speedup whose only change is pure invertible recoding. Therefore a genuine improvement needs a changed search policy, rules, compilation, resource model, or another non-recoding ingredient.
intended_use: Guards theorem-fishing experiments against counting relabeling as computational progress.

title: Uniform branching bounds history growth
statement: If every state reachable within the first n steps has at most b < ∞ legal labeled actions, then Mn (S0) ≤ bn, using b0 = 1 also for b = 0.
proof: At depth zero there is one empty history. Each length-j history has at most b extensions, so induction gives at most bj histories at depth j ≤ n.
intended_use: Supplies a finite enumeration bound under an explicit branching bound; finitary inference alone does not imply finite branching.

title: Causal BANK depth never exceeds the cumulative depth budget at deposit time
statement: If λ is deposited by update n, then δ(λ) ≤ Qn.
proof: Theorem 8.3 observes that each dependency segment used by the target is bounded by its deposit’s qi, while Qn sums all segment budgets up to n.
intended_use: Orders the two AMLD potential measures and explains why the causal one can be sharper.

title: Picard attains level omega under the formal idealization
statement: Under Definition 20.1’s Picard idealization, lev(Picard) = ω.
proof: This is the Picard theorem of Section 20. The conclusion is about the formal idealization under its stated premises.
intended_use: Provides a named level-ω witness without turning the result into an empirical claim about a human mind.

title: Unrestricted translations are too weak to support a discriminating order
statement: If translations are allowed without the source admissibility restrictions, the proposed comparison collapses in the manner shown by Proposition 16.3.
proof: Proposition 16.3 constructs the collapse, so admissibility is a necessary design response within this framework.
intended_use: Explains why a syntax-respecting translation class is mathematically substantive.

title: Birth-time induction can prove properties unavailable from stage membership alone
statement: If a property is established for inputs and for every formula at the moment it is first born from earlier formulas with that property, then every formula with finite birth time has the property.
proof: Apply strong induction to the natural-number birth time as in Supplement Theorem 10.
intended_use: Provides the ancestor of the later cooperative BANK birth-time method.

title: The Discovery witness class survives strengthening to any realized positive level
statement: Under the source strengthening parameterized by a positive finite level or ω, the existence claim remains inhabited as stated in Proposition 18.7.
proof: The proposition reuses the hierarchy witnesses to meet the stronger level requirement.
intended_use: Shows the existential content is not tied to the weakest positive level.

title: The Picard idealization is a nondegenerate formal witness
statement: Under the same idealization and the corrected nondegeneracy criterion, Picard is a nondegenerate witness in the source sense.
proof: Corollary 20.7 records the conclusion from the Picard theorem plus the criterion.
intended_use: Distinguishes nondegeneracy of a formal witness from mere Level-ω attainment.

title: The Tegmark condition is upward closed under admissible comparison
statement: If M satisfies the source Tegmark condition and M ⪯adm SA N, then N also satisfies it.
proof: This is the upward-closure proposition of Section 17.
intended_use: Makes the condition compatible with the admissible order rather than isolated to single presentations.

title: Intrinsic distance lower-bounds any realized successful route
statement: If a policy trajectory uses edges of a fixed unit-cost graph and starts at s, then dist(s, W) ≤ Hπhit (W).
proof: If the policy hits at time n, its prefix is an n-edge path to W, so shortest distance is at most n. If it never hits, the right side is infinite.
intended_use: Valid only when the two quantities refer to the same graph and cost unit; primitive proof steps and ATP expansions are not automatically comparable.

title: Halting persistence implies permanent state freezing under the SIC axioms
statement: Once H(Γ, h) = 1, every later stage remains halted and has the same frozen state required by the SIC definition.
proof: Proposition 18 propagates the halting predicate forward; the SIC freezing axiom then propagates the state equality stage by stage.
intended_use: Supports stable settlement records after target attainment.

title: Phi is typed as a mechanism property in the source comparison
statement: Under the source’s chosen IIT terminology, Φ belongs to the mechanism-description side rather than being a property deter- mined by self-theory alone.
proof: Proposition 22.6 states this type distinction.
intended_use: Keeps a conditional cross-framework comparison from collapsing distinct mathematical objects.

title: Trace SICs are computable for deterministic Turing machines
statement: For a deterministic Turing machine with the source effective encoding, the corresponding trace SIC has a computable stage evolution.
proof: Proposition B.17 simulates the finite number of machine steps required to obtain each encoded stage.
intended_use: Shows a broad class of SICs are ordinary effective computational objects.

title: Effective-state computable SICs admit Turing presentations
statement: On an effectively presented state domain, the computable SIC notion and the source Turing-machine realization notion coincide as stated by corrected Theorem B.18.
proof: The correction supplies the exact equivalence only after the state-domain effectiveness requirement is imposed.
intended_use: Closes the representation gap that would otherwise hide noncomputable state access.

title: Premise enlargement cannot lengthen a shortest proof
statement: If A ⊆ B ⊆ y, then ∥φ∥F (B) ≤ ∥φ∥F (A) in N ∪ {∞}.
proof: Every proof from A is also a proof from B. The set over which the minimum is taken for B therefore contains the set for A.
intended_use: This monotonicity is the object-level template later reused for BANK road-building.

title: Formal universality is an existence result inside the specified framework
statement: The formal content of the source universality conjecture is settled in the affirmative in the precise sense stated by Theorem 21.4.
proof: Theorem 21.4 supplies the formal witness and explicitly scopes the conclusion.
intended_use: Records settlement without extending it beyond the formalized content.

title: Internal necessitation plus Level 1 yields Level omega
statement: A tagged ATP satisfying the hypotheses of Theorem 15.27 proves every finite reflection iterate and therefore attains level ω.
proof: Theorem 15.27 iterates internal necessitation through all finite reflection levels.
intended_use: Provides a sufficient mechanism for maximal finite reflection.

title: Distinct reflection formulas prevent level collapse by syntactic identity
statement: The finite reflection sequence θ0, θ1,... contains pairwise distinct formulas, so proving a later level cannot be explained by the later formula being literally the same string as an earlier one.
proof: This is the pairwise-distinctness conclusion of Proposition 15.14.
intended_use: Protects the hierarchy from trivial syntactic collapse.

title: Transfinite reflection levels are pairwise syntactically distinct in the specified calculus
statement: For the transfinite sequence considered in Section 21, θα ̸= θβ whenever α ̸= β < κ.
proof: This is Proposition 21.14.
intended_use: Provides the syntactic separation needed before asking whether different ordinal levels are semantically or order-theoretically distinct.

title: AMLD architecture alone gives no universal total-work inequality
statement: Neither WA ≤ W⋆ nor WA ≥ W⋆ holds on every target merely from using five roles.
proof: Proposition 7.1 gives cases in both directions: losing roles can waste work, while early alternative settlement can terminate before the baseline spends its full work budget.
intended_use: Separates parallel opportunity from aggregate computational cost.

title: Computability requires an effective state presentation
statement: A claim that a SIC is simulated by a Turing machine is licensed only after the SIC state domain is effectively presented as required by corrected Theorem 9.15.
proof: The correction makes effective presentation an explicit hypothesis. Dropping it would ask a Turing machine to operate on states without a computable representation.
intended_use: Prevents hidden coding assumptions in ATP/Turing comparisons.

title: Finite observed performance does not refute a dispositional level-omega idealization
statement: Under the source dispositional reading, having proved only finitely many reflection formulas by a given time is compatible with the formal Level-ω idealization.
proof: Proposition 20.21 separates finite current performance from the dispositional premise used by the theorem.
intended_use: Clarifies a competence/performance distinction inside the formal model.

title: The Picard construction is uniform over any system satisfying the same formal premises
statement: Replacing Picard by an arbitrary tagged ATP X satisfying the formal premises (P1)–(P4) yields the same corresponding formal conclusion stated in Proposition 20.19.
proof: Proposition 20.19 is the uniformity theorem: the proof uses the premises, not an irreducible proper name.
intended_use: Identifies which part of the argument is structural rather than biographical.

title: Self-representation does not require arithmetic coding
statement: A tagged ATP may have a valid internal representation even when that representation is introduced as a formal name rather than as a Gödel number.
proof: Proposition 13.2 explicitly allows a syntactic name with intended denotation and imposes no arithmetic-encoding requirement.
intended_use: Keeps the framework syntactic rather than tying it to a particular numeral coding.

title: The Picard premises are jointly formally instantiable
statement: The source assumptions (P1)–(P4) are jointly satisfiable by a formal construction.
proof: Corollary 21.2 discharges the formal instantiability question using the reflection-closure machine.
intended_use: Separates consistency/instantiability of the formal premise package from empirical attribution.

title: Positive formal self-awareness is inhabited
statement: The class of tagged ATPs with positive formal self-awareness is nonempty.
proof: Proposition 18.2 supplies explicit witness existence from the earlier constructions.
intended_use: Separates an existence theorem from broader philosophical interpretations.

title: Competence and finite performance are formally separable
statement: The source formalization admits a system with the relevant competence/dispositional property even when only finite perfor- mance is observed at a stage.
proof: Theorem 21.6 is the formal content of the competence–performance gap.
intended_use: Prevents a finite run prefix from being identified with the full dispositional theory.

title: Changing only the legal-move ranking cannot create a false theorem
statement: With a fixed sound verifier, fixed formal environment, and unchanged certificate semantics, replacing one legal-move scor- ing/ranking policy by another cannot make the ATP accept a non-theorem.
proof: Proposition 1.2 separates proposal order from verifier acceptance: only verifier-accepted certificates enter the trusted output.
intended_use: Formalizes the trust boundary for learned or heuristic search guidance.

title: Positive Level 1 implies a nonempty self-theory
statement: Every Level-1 formally self-aware ATP has at least one theorem in its self-theory.
proof: Proposition 15.4 supplies the implication directly.
intended_use: Makes Level 1 a genuinely nonempty formal condition.

title: One layer can hide the full range of discovery offsets
statement: A finite layer of N ≥ 1 candidates with exactly one successful candidate admits an ordering that succeeds first and another that succeeds at position N, without changing the successful depth.
proof: Place the successful candidate first or last. Both orderings contain the same candidates in the same layer.
intended_use: Shows what ordering can change before asserting any special advantage for Hilbert, lexicographic, learned, or randomized policies.

title: AMLD introduces no fifth foundational induction axiom
statement: Global AMLD induction and cooperative BANK birth-time induction are ordinary inductions on natural-number chronologies, supplemented by finite induction through certificate DAGs.
proof: This is Proposition 9.1.
intended_use: Places cooperative reasoning inside the existing induction hierarchy rather than advertising a new foundational principle.

title: Zero inference horizon identifies existing premises
statement: For finite initial premises B, HFinf (B, T) = 0 if and only if T ∈ B.
proof: An existing premise requires no inference. Conversely, a proof with no non-premise inference applications contains only premises and cannot introduce a different target.
intended_use: Fixes a base case used in BANK-horizon calculations.

title: Enlarging the target cannot increase distance
statement: For target regions W ⊆ W ′ and any state s, dist(s, W ′) ≤ dist(s, W), with ∞ allowed.
proof: Every path ending in W also ends in W ′. Minimize over the larger set of eligible paths.
intended_use: Separates target enlargement from adding moves or changing the search policy.

title: A simple sufficient condition for a static meet
statement: For a nonempty finite family of static machines, put c = mini hi and d = mini ui. If c + d is a positive power of two, the meet within the static subclass is S(c, d).
proof: It is an allowed lower bound. Every other lower bound has both coordinates at most c, d, so lies below it.
intended_use: Provides positive cases alongside the nonlattice theorem.

title: Logical horizon monotonicity does not imply heuristic runtime monotonicity
statement: Even though hJ (k) is nonincreasing, a fixed heuristic may run slower after BANK growth because branching, indexing, duplicate work, or memory pressure can increase.
proof: The shortest available route and the route actually discovered by a policy are different quantities.
intended_use: Keeps proof geometry separate from implementation effort.

title: Logical-round dominance does not imply wall-clock dominance without resource replication
statement: The emulation inequality can fail as a wall-clock statement if P loses processor time, verifier service, memory, or scheduling priority relative to the stand-alone prover.
proof: Theorem 6.3 counts local opportunities, while Remark 6.4 lists resource-sharing mechanisms that break the wall-clock comparison.
intended_use: Prevents a scheduling theorem from being overread as a hardware-speed theorem.

title: Equal self-theories need not force equal mechanism properties
statement: There can be two presented mechanisms that agree on the relevant self-theory data while differing on a mechanism property covered by LF-IIT22.1.
proof: If self-theory determined every such mechanism property, the separation asserted by LF-IIT22.1 would be impossible.
intended_use: Gives a negative reconstruction result: theorem content alone need not recover full mechanism structure.

title: Formal self-awareness level is not forced by computational complexity alone
statement: No implication from the source complexity criterion alone to positive formal self-awareness can hold in this framework.
proof: LF-D18.3 supplies a counterexample satisfying the complexity side while having level zero.
intended_use: Prevents complexity from being used as a proxy for the formal level definition.

title: Dependency depth is bounded by inference-node count
statement: A finite certificate DAG with q primitive inference nodes has maximum primitive inference depth at most q.
proof: A directed path in a DAG cannot repeat a node. Hence every such path contains at most the total number q of inference nodes.
intended_use: Provides a consistency check without equating depth and size; branching and sharing can separate them.

title: Metalogical records cannot be silently used as object-level premises
statement: A D- or I-channel certificate stored in the metalogical BANK is not an F -premise unless a separately verified object-level formula is deposited into the object BANK.
proof: The architecture declares the BANK components type-distinct, so membership in one does not imply legal use in the other.
intended_use: Prevents a type error from masquerading as cooperative deduction.

title: A legal path weight is zero only when a step has zero policy weight
statement: For the idealized product pθ,T (π) = constituent step has positive weight. Q j pθ,T (aj | Sj), the path has positive weight whenever every
proof: A finite product of positive real numbers is positive. Standard softmax assigns positive weight to every finite-score legal move.
intended_use: Distinguishes low probability from outright policy exclusion.

title: A proof or refutation already implies dependence
statement: If B ⊢F T or B ⊢F T −, then DepF,B (T) holds.
proof: Dependence is defined as the disjunction of those two derivability predicates.
intended_use: Shows why the D channel is an architectural role, not a fifth exclusive truth value.

title: A shorter explicit-premise horizon need not shorten the fully expanded proof
statement: A BANK lemma can reduce ∥T ∥F (Bk) while leaving the primitive proof from B0 just as long once the lemma’s own certificate is expanded.
proof: The explicit-premise measure treats deposited lemmas as premises; full expansion charges the derivation used to create them.
intended_use: Prevents macro compression from being misreported as an unconditional primitive-proof speedup.

title: One useful deposited intermediate suffices in the toy system
statement: For the exact rule set r1 (a, b) = c, r2 (c) = d, r3 (b) = e, r4 (e) = d and B0 = {a, b}, adjoining either c or e reduces the inference horizon of d from two to one. Adjoining both still gives horizon one; adjoining d itself gives zero.
proof: Initially neither rule concluding d has its required premise, and each missing premise can be obtained in one step, so exactly two steps are necessary and sufficient. Either c or e enables a one-step final rule. With both, d is still not an initial premise, so zero steps are impossible. With d as a premise, zero steps suffice.
intended_use: Exhibits redundant additional BANK material for a fixed target, rather than assuming every extra deposit strictly improves its horizon.

title: Equal scores produce a uniform legal-move policy
statement: If sθ (S, a) is the same constant for every a ∈ A(S), then pθ,T (a | S) = 1/|A(S)| for every legal move.
proof: All exponentials in numerator and denominator are equal, so each gets one equal share of the total.
intended_use: Provides a neutral reference policy inside the same legal action set.

title: A fixed-instance finite-budget win is not an asymptotic speedup theorem
statement: The reported prcom separation alone cannot establish an asymptotic speedup claim for a target family.
proof: An asymptotic theorem requires a scaling family and proved performance bounds as the size parameter grows; the source run supplies one right-censored finite instance.
intended_use: Keeps empirical proof-of-concept evidence within its declared scope.

title: A discovery-cost separation is not a proof-length separation
statement: Different expansion counts for two searches do not imply that their emitted verifier-accepted certificates have different proof lengths.
proof: Expansion discovery cost counts search states; proof length counts the certificate under a separate convention. Neither definition determines the other.
intended_use: Prevents performance evidence from being restated as a proof-complexity theorem.

title: Timeout cannot certify independence
statement: Failure of P and R to find certificates within a finite budget does not establish IndF,B (T).
proof: Independence requires both nonderivability statements, whereas timeout records only absence of discovery within the observed search budget.
intended_use: Protects the verifier boundary against converting failed search into metatheory.

title: Softmax legal-move probabilities normalize
statement: For finite nonempty A(S) and T > 0, the idealized softmax weights satisfy P a∈A(S) pθ,T (a | S) = 1.
proof: The common denominator is exactly the sum of all numerators exp(sθ (S, a)/T) over A(S).
intended_use: Checks that the displayed learned weighting is a probability distribution on the frozen legal action fiber.
